remarks: Step into this beautifully renovated home and be captivated by its fresh and modern appeal. Recently painted, the interior exudes a sense of freshness and brightness. The updated appliances in the kitchen bring efficiency and style to your culinary adventures.   As you move through the home, you'll notice brand new 4" white oak hardwood flooring, adding a touch of sophistication and durability to every room. The large closets with shelving provide ample storage and organization for your belongings, keeping everything neat and tidy.   The upper bath has undergone a stunning transformation, featuring a glass shower enclosure and a custom vanity, offering a spa-like experience within the comfort of your own home.   Step outside to the brand new patio, thoughtfully designed with raised planting beds, perfect for cultivating your favorite flowers or herbs. The 10' high fence to the rear neighbor ensures privacy and a peaceful outdoor retreat.   Admire the backyard, surrounded by a newly stained cedar fence, adorned with rose bushes, adding a touch of elegance and natural beauty to the landscape. The well-manicured lawn and new front plantings create an inviting curb appeal.The single-car detached garage is not only practical but also equipped with electric and LED lighting, making it a versatile space for various needs. Additional exterior covered storage between the patio and garage offers a convenient space to store bikes, kayaks, and more.  Excellent credit, proof
